pr_title: Refactor "refs/*" string usage by using constants
pr_body:
Fixes #16478

I tried my best to refactor everything, but I left a few spots:
- the DB migration code, as I suspect this represent the status of the DB at a moment in time, and should be left untouched in case the value of the const change
- the tests (kinda for the same reason)
- one function in ./modules/structs/hook.go , as it create a  loop git git/ref.go, and fixing that mean a bigger refactor, which is maybe not the solution (maybe moving the function somewhere else ?)

Then there is various format strings, like  ```ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/pull/%s/head:%s", pr, branchRef)```.

On one hand, I think they should also be refactored, on the other, I wonder if this doesn't make the code less readable.
pr_comments:
> On one hand, I think they should also be refactored, on the other, I wonder if this doesn't make the code less readable.

You could see these constant as a "magically crafted string", but with a explanation as what it means. It doesn't necessary just contribute to readability of the code.
I will do a quick pass at the format string later today as well (since my understanding of @Gusted comment is that using the constant wouldn't be "too much")

issue_context.title: git ref Prefix should be const's in modules/git/ref.go
issue_context.body:
... it need a refactor ...
-> I propose to move things into modules/git/ref.go and replace strings in code with that const ... witch is worth it's own pull

_Originally posted by @6543 in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/14295#discussion_r671834787_

* `refs/tags`
* `refs/heads`
* `refs/remotes`
...

review_comments: Bit unfair that only PullPrefix gets a `xxxLen` constant ;)
Yeah, I felt this would be overhead for the others. But consistency is important too.

Same issue:
```suggestion
			Ref:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/head", git.PullPrefix, pr.Index),
```
Maybe you can send another PR.

Same issue:
```suggestion
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/head", git.PullPrefix, p.Number)
```

Is there a reason why this isn't
```suggestion
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/head", git.PullPrefix, pr.Index)
```

Is there a reason why this isn't
```suggestion
		ref := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s/head:%s", gitea_git.PullPrefix, pr, branchRef)
```
No specific reason other than I didn't thought of it. Your proposal is indeed more elegant.
